HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

5. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.

11. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain National Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Plan income and spending wisely

3. C — Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

7. C — Nairobi

8. B — Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyans Response to Colonialism; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of National Security; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
